title: Keto Mediterranean Chickpea Fritters
description: A keto spin on traditional fritters, using chickpea flour and flavorful Mediterranean ingredients. Perfect as a snack or side dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chickpea flour, feta cheese, muffin mix, olive oil, garlic powder, and dried oregano. Mix well.
Add chopped parsley and mix until combined.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop mixture into balls and flatten slightly.
Place fritters on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
